digest.component_or_area: LLM provider qualification and model id parsing
propositions: Provider qualification must be decided by membership in a static KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES set rather than regex shape matching, to validate configured providers at config resolution time and reject typos like 'bedrok' early
A static frozenset of 24 known provider names replaces the shape regex _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE, matching the membership-based approach used by LangChain and LiteLLM and pydantic-ai's own infer_model

split_provider_qualifier returns (prefix, rest) only when prefix is a known member, falling back to (None, model) for unrecognized inline prefixes including model ids with dots and colons that are not providers

An explicitly configured provider is validated against KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES in _resolve_target and raises LLMConfigError naming the invalid value and listing valid options, improving diagnostic accuracy over shape-based rejection
The static set remains free of optional imports, keeping 'import rebar.llm' stdlib-only per the module's design constraint, verified by test_core_optionality
Neither 'test' nor 'google_genai' are members of the final set, aligning rebar with upstream pydantic-ai's own strict provider registry and eliminating synthetic/unusable provider names
